## Decisions

- Preserve the existing five-provider account, session and scoped-partition
  state machine. Add one independently authored six-slot glass indicator driven
  only by a validated active provider or explicit multi-provider mode, with no
  optimistic activation before a trusted desktop login-success event.
- Keep the existing single search DOM and request pipeline shared by the main
  and secondary interfaces. Add only an independently authored CSS border-light
  layer, stable clear action, focus-visible treatment, and IME composition
  gating without geometry movement.
- Keep the existing weather layout and WMO data flow. Replace only the current
  and seven-day forecast glyphs with independently authored inline SVG parts
  and CSS motion, paused when hidden, off-screen, minimized, or reduced-motion.
- Preserve the existing six-card Home layout and interactions. Add only
  pointer-local purple-blue border glow and two grid-junction lights through one
  shared pointer listener and an on-demand animation frame.
